verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the clear focal point at a readable size and in the original's reading order (headline, then cats), but the cat cluster is shrunk to a tiny afterthought jammed in the bottom-right corner, with a big dead gap between it and the headline and an unused left margin. B makes the cats larger, but it shrinks the headline to small, weak text, flips the reading order so the image comes first, and squeezes everything into a centre band with large empty areas at both ends, so the hierarchy and use of space are worse.
